test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the number set which is different from the rest.
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 
• (50, 85) ⇒ 50 and 85 are divisible by 5.
 
• (63, 91) ⇒ 63 and 91 are divisible by 7.
 
• (32, 48) ⇒ 32 and 48 are divisible by 2, 4, 8, and 16
 
• (14, 27) ⇒ 14 and 27 have no common factors.

 
• Thus, the set (14, 27) is different from the rest.

Hence, "(14, 27)" is the correct answer.
